title: Does a One-Size-Fits-All Minimum Wage Cause Financial Stress for Small Businesses?
eligible_reason: The treatment is not a staggered binary adoption. The main regressor BC = Bound(s,t-1) x dollar increase in the federal minimum wage in year t (Cleaning/1_MW.do line 169) is continuous and nonzero only in federal-increase years (1990, 1991, 1996, 1997, 2007, 2008, 2009). The binary variant BD = Bound x 1[federal increase] (Table 3 column 8) is a transitory pulse that switches off in the following year, and the time-varying Bound(s,t-1) indicator (state minimum wage at or below the federal rate in t-1; share of bound states ranges from 37% to 90% across 1989-2013 and moves in both directions) enters every column as an additional regressor. Column 9 of Table 3 splits the pulse by episode. No column regresses an outcome on an absorbing binary treatment with unit and time fixed effects.
design_notes: Establishment-year panel from NETS (dnum; 1990-2014 snapshots lagged one year), outcome avg_paydex (D&B Paydex credit score; also paydexmin, paydexmax, days-payable conversions, exit). Table 2 Panel A (Tables_Figures/Table2.do lines 63-84): reghdfe {paydexmin, paydexmax, avg_paydex} BC bound, a(year dnum) clus(statefips); cols 4-6 add lagged establishment controls $FC = l_log_emp l_log_sales l_log_age l_sales_growth. Panel B: same with Paydex converted to days outstanding. Table 3 (Table3.do): robustness (bound x controls, naics4#year FE, no industry drop, multi-establishment firms, BMW percent change, BD dummy, episode-specific BD_fy/BD_sy/BD_ty). Table 4 (Table4.do): contiguous border-county pairs, a(dnum year#cpair) with BC and bound, distance interactions, house-price controls. Table 5 (Table5.do line 140): exemption-threshold design, trt2_ex x post_k (dollar amounts of the 2007-2009 federal increases by relative year) x bound2006 with a(fips##year#naics4 trt2_ex##bound dnum). Table 8: exit outcome on border pairs. Figures 3-5: pre-trend plots and heterogeneity (c.BC#i.group).
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Not an adoption design; federal increases hit all bound states in the same years (3 episodes: 1990-91, 1996-97, 2007-09) and bound status is itself time-varying and reversible.
never_treated_note: Unbound states have BC = 0 but can become bound later; the bound indicator is in the regression.

specs.exclusion_reason: continuous treatment (bound x dollar federal MW change); additional time-varying regressor bound; treatment is a transitory pulse, not an absorbing adoption
specs.treatment_var: BC (= bound x fed_change_max) and bound
specs.treatment_definition: bound = 1 if the state's maximum minimum wage in t-1 <= federal minimum wage in t-1 (1_MW.do lines 149-151); fed_change_max = dollar increase in the federal MW in t; BC = bound x fed_change_max
specs.sample_condition: hqdnum==. & emp>1; lagged controls non-missing ($Z); utilities/finance/etc. industries dropped ($D)

specs.exclusion_reason: binary pulse treatment (switches off after the increase year); additional regressor bound; time-varying controls
specs.treatment_var: BD (= bound x dum_fed_change_max) and bound
specs.treatment_definition: BD = 1 in years with a federal MW increase for states bound in t-1; 0 otherwise
specs.notes: Column 9 (line 144) splits BD into episode years fy/sy/ty.

specs.exclusion_reason: triple interaction with continuous dollar amounts post_k and threshold indicator trt2_ex; bandwidth sample around $500k sales
specs.treatment_var: trt2_ex_post_0_exe..trt2_ex_post_4_exe (= trt2_ex x post_k x bound2006) and trt2_ex_post_0..4
specs.treatment_definition: trt2_ex = establishment above the FLSA $500k sales exemption threshold (or non-exempt in exempting states); post_k = dollar federal increase by relative year 2007-2011

data_access_note: NETS (Dun & Bradstreet) establishment data acquired under non-sharing terms; the package ships 100-observation random samples of nets_sample.dta, nets_startyear.dta, hq_name.dta, zip_firms.dta and Regression_Full.dta, plus complete public minimum-wage (Vaghul-Zipperer) and county/state control files and all Stata logs.
data_files: DataForMS/*.dta public controls (HP_grw, IRS_income, unemployment, state_economy_2011_selected, Income_Inequality, HHI5, Bordering_*)
Logs/*.smcl (real-data logs for all tables and figures)
screener_notes: Screened from package only. Treatment construction read from Cleaning/1_MW.do and 2_MW_NETS_Full.do; bound/federal-change pattern by year verified from VZ_state_annual_n2.dta. Cited Cengiz et al. (2019) but no bunching or stacked estimator appears in the code.
